L.method: Reviewed source-only support annotation; raw heights and velocities retained; Inspected 49_06 source front and three-quarter poses and full-rate hand trajectories. Right low-hand support precedes left during inversion. Converted hand landmarks sit 0.089 to 0.181 m above the toe-derived floor; these are inferred physical palm supports, not claims of millimetre-accurate raw capture. No target geometry or score was consulted.
